purpose: Produce a real Switch NRO containing canonical Uniracers guest objects plus authoritative SNES runtime/support objects behind a minimal non-simulating Switch host.

host_contract.threading: single-threaded probe; no audio device/thread is created, so no-op APU lock is valid only for this non-simulating link skeleton

acceptance: final AArch64 executable link resolves all symbols against host shim and Switch/newlib/libm
the probe does not call SnesInit or RtlRunFrame
non_claims: The NRO does not start the Uniracers simulation
The NRO does not initialize audio delivery
The NRO does not prove frame presentation
The NRO does not prove deterministic parity
Gate S2 remains open until authoritative simulation executes and matches retained checkpoints
